answer_1.quote: We propose the argument explication task ... generate claim, reasons, and warrant. ... our two-stage framework ... prompts an LM ... to obtain the argument components.

answer_2.quote: We measure semantic similarity between generated and gold claim, using ROUGE-L and BERTScore... To mitigate this issue, we adopt FactScore... Similarity between gold and generated warrants, measured using BERTScore, is low...

answer_4.quote: We hired two freelancers on Upwork ... who were shown a claim‑reason pair and three warrants (gold, GPT‑4 and Llama‑2‑generated; in random order), and were asked to mark all the warrants they consider acceptable.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to mark a warrant as acceptable if it (a) is relevant and fully explains the link between the claim‑reason pair, (b) is not trivial (i.e., not of the form 'if reason then claim'), and (c) must hold for the claim to be inferred from the reason.
